input_cognitive_load.evidence: Read tools previously required tool-specific fields such as agent_id, dag_key, run_key, path, prompt_key, and card_key. Phase 1 adds a shared pos selector.

schema_consistency.evidence: Read schemas now expose pos and do not require legacy selector fields.

hint_quality.evidence: invalid_pos and pos_conflict use coded tool errors with next-step hints.

findings.summary: Read tools had multiple selector field names, increasing AI reasoning cost.
findings.fix: Added shared pos parsing and resolver helpers.

findings.summary: Mutation tools still use legacy selector fields.
